headword: {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}

definitions.explanation: The most common type of business corporation in Japan, equivalent to a limited company or corporation. Abbreviated as (株) in company names.

examples.japanese: {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}した→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}ABC⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧です。
examples.english: He is the president of ABC Corporation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{資本金|しほんきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一円|いちえん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧になった。
examples.english: In Japan, it has become possible to create a corporation with as little as one yen in capital.

notes: Often abbreviated as ({株|かぶ}) in written contexts, placed either before or after the company name: {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}トヨタ or トヨタ{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}. The position (before or after) is determined by the company's official registration. Other Japanese corporate forms include {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ} (LLC, abbreviated ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧), {合資会社|ごうしがいしゃ} (limited partnership), and {合名会社|ごうめいがいしゃ} (general partnership). Colloquially often shortened to ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧ when referring to shares or the stock market.
